thread:
maria (Finance): Hey @kevin @sasha — batch run 2024-07-pricing-exp (batch_id=pr-exp-20240712) produced a bunch of bad invoices. Some customers got billed at the new experimental per-token tier mid-cycle, others at the old tier. Also seeing missing reserved GPU line items for ~12 accounts and a few customers received duplicate invoices after the retry job ran. :grimacing.
kevin (Billing Eng): Ugh. Can you paste a sample invoice id and the exact batch id? I want the logs for the reconciliation step. :eyes:
maria (Finance): Sample invoice: INV-20240712-9931, affected customer orgs: [cleardata, metricloop, novaai]. Batch id: pr-exp-20240712. Attached the run output from invoice-gen:
```
INFO reconcile:start batch=pr-exp-20240712
WARN pricing:experiment-switch customer=metricloop old_tier=std new_tier=exp_v2 at=2024-07-12T03:14:22Z
ERROR linegen:missing reserved_gpu_line for customer=cleardata
INFO retry:spawned invoice_retry job=retry-20240712-01
INFO invoice:create id=INV-20240712-9931 status=created
INFO invoice:create id=INV-20240712-9931 status=duplicate_detection->retries_allowed
```
kevin (Billing Eng): Looks like the pricing experiment flag flipped at 03:14Z while usage windows were still being processed. The retry job spawned and re-created invoices without uniquing the invoice_hash when the experiment flag changed. That explains duplicates. For missing reserved GPU lines, I need the usage rows for cleardata. Can you export usage rows for window [2024-07-11T22:00Z..2024-07-12T04:00Z]?
sasha (Platform): Re: dedupe — the invoice service uses invoice_hash = sha(user_id + billing_window + tier_version). If tier_version changed mid-window, we get different hashes -> duplicate invoices. We should fallback to canonical tier_version for the billing window (the one active at window_cutoff). Quick patch: if billing_window_end < experiment_switch_ts then force tier_version=previous in invoice_hash. I can put a canary out for one org.
maria (Finance): Can we also detect "missing reserved_gpu_line" and auto-recreate before finalizing? Support already has 6 open tickets. @allen any high-priority customers we should credit first?
allen (Support): Cleardata and NovaAI are both P1 — they lost reserved GPU lines which materially inflated their net due (went 0 -> $0 missing compute). Cleardata pinged support this morning. We should issue temporary credit notes asap.
kevin (Billing Eng): Plan: 1) Run canary with sasha's patch on cleardata only (non-prod flag), 2) Recompute invoice lines and regenerate invoice draft, 3) If diffs look good, re-run reconciliation for full batch with dedupe fix, 4) Void duplicate invoice copies and issue credits where necessary. Who owns credits?
maria (Finance): Finance will approve emergency credits up to $50k aggregated for the affected accounts. I'll open a quick PR to the credits queue. Can you estimate time for canary?
sasha (Platform): Canary for cleardata should take ~30m plus validation. I'll push a small change to the invoice service and deploy to staging -> canary in prod for that org. Rolling the full fix will be after green canary.
kevin (Billing Eng): I wrote a small script to find duplicates from that batch:
```
SELECT invoice_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM invoices
WHERE batch_id='pr-exp-20240712'
GROUP BY invoice_id HAVING cnt>1;
```
I'll run it after the canary and post results. If there are >50 duplicates we'll throttle the re-run.
maria (Finance): Thanks. Also tagging @billing-bot to create a ticket in the billing-incident queue and to notify the affected customers with a templated apology + that a credit is pending. billing-bot: please include invoice ids and clear next steps. :point_down:
billing-bot: Created incident BI-2024-0712-pricing-exp. Notified cleardata, metricloop, novaai. Template used: "We're investigating an invoice generation issue affecting your July 12 invoice; a temporary credit will be applied if needed. Contact support for urgent disputes."
allen (Support): I'll coordinate refunds/credits once finance PR is merged. For audit we should tag all voids with reason=pricing-experiment-midcycle in the ledger.
kevin (Billing Eng): I'll share logs + duplicate list in ~45m. Posting the remediation PR shortly.
sasha (Platform): I'll schedule the canary now. Will ping here when done.
maria (Finance): Great — keep this thread for updates. If anyone needs a quick sync, let's do a 15m stand in 20m. :thumbsup:
kevin (Billing Eng): ack
sasha (Platform): ack
allen (Support): ack
